from textwrap import dedent
import re

def parse_claim(text):
    match = re.match(r'<CLAIM field="(\w+)" good="(\w+)" value="(\d+)" />', text)
    if match:
        return {
            'field': match.group(1),
            'good': match.group(2),
            'value': match.group(3)
        }
    return None

def parse_offer(text):
    match = re.match(r'<OFFER good="(\w+)" qty="(\d+)" price="(\d+)" />', text)
    if match:
        return {
            'good': match.group(1),
            'qty': match.group(2),
            'price': match.group(3)
        }
    return None

def parse_action(text):
    match = re.match(r'<(\w+) good="(\w+)" />', text)
    if match:
        return {
            'action': match.group(1),
            'good': match.group(2)
        }
    return None

def parse_message(text):
    match = re.match(r'<MESSAGE>(.*?)</MESSAGE>', text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return match.group(1).strip()
    return None

def parse_scratchpad(text):
    match = re.match(r'<SCRATCHPAD>(.*?)</SCRATCHPAD>', text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return match.group(1).strip()
    return None

def parse_plan(text):
    match = re.match(r'<PLAN>(.*?)</PLAN>', text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return match.group(1).strip()
    return None

def parse_message_structure(text):
    claims = []
    offers = []
    actions = []
    message = None
    scratchpad = None
    plan = None

    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    for line in lines:
        claim = parse_claim(line)
        if claim:
            claims.append(claim)
            continue

        offer = parse_offer(line)
        if offer:
            offers.append(offer)
            continue

        action = parse_action(line)
        if action:
            actions.append(action)
            continue

        message = parse_message(line)
        if message:
            continue

        scratchpad = parse_scratchpad(line)
        if scratchpad:
            continue

        plan = parse_plan(line)
        if plan:
            continue

    return {
        'claims': claims,
        'offers': offers,
        'actions': actions,
        'message': message,
        'scratchpad': scratchpad,
        'plan': plan
    }

def validate_structure(text):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    scratchpad_found = False
    message_found = False
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('<SCRATCHPAD>'):
            scratchpad_found = True
            continue
        if line.startswith('<MESSAGE>'):
            message_found = True
            continue

    if not scratchpad_found or not message_found:
        return False

    # Check if the last line is <PLAN>
    if not lines[-1].startswith('<PLAN>'):
        return False

    # Check if all OFFER tags have corresponding CLAIM tags
    offers = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('<OFFER')]
    if offers:
        claims = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('<CLAIM')]
        if len(claims) < len(offers):
            return False

    return True
